title: BÜCHI Labortechnik AG
content: BÜCHI Labortechnik AG is a Swiss laboratory equipment manufacturer known for evaporation, spray drying, extraction, and lyophilization systems. These process tools are relevant to aerogel formulation, solvent exchange, drying, and analytical sample-preparation workflows. BÜCHI is a strong Equipment Materials listing for research and pilot teams needing reliable laboratory process platforms.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
